description: Plaintext game HTTP, connection-flow and router-postfilter signals for DDoS investigation. High rates and volumes are review prompts, not intent or a violation verdict.
title: DDoS

targets.expr: min(forcad:game_sensor_ready or on (job, instance) (0 * up{job="forcad_game_sensor"}))

panels.title: Sensor ready
panels.description: Healthy means every configured game sensor is up, current and inventory-matched. No data means no sensor target is configured.

targets.expr: max(time() - forcad_game_sync_timestamp_seconds)

panels.title: Sensor heartbeat age
panels.description: Sensors older than 45 seconds are excluded from traffic queries; investigate stale values before interpreting rates.

targets.expr: sum(rate(forcad_game_capture_dropped_packets_total[1m]))

panels.title: Capture drops/s
panels.description: Kernel capture drops across sensors. Any sustained nonzero rate can make observed traffic incomplete.

targets.expr: sum(rate(forcad_game_stream_gaps_total[1m]))

panels.title: Stream gaps/s
panels.description: TCP stream gaps across sensors. Nonzero values can reflect packet loss, offload effects or asymmetric visibility.

targets.expr: min(forcad_network_source_scrape_success{job="forcad_router"} or on (job, instance) (0 * up{job="forcad_router"}))

panels.title: Router counters
panels.description: Healthy means every configured router exporter is up and its source-to-vulnbox counter scrape succeeded.

targets.expr: sort_desc((sum by (team_ip) (rate(forcad_network_source_packets_total{job="forcad_router"}[1m]) and on (job, instance) (forcad_network_source_scrape_success{job="forcad_router"} == 1 and on (job, instance) up{job="forcad_router"} == 1)) * on (team_ip) group_left (team_id) forcad:team_network_info:unique * on (team_id) group_left (team_name) max by (team_id, team_name) (forcad:team_info:latest{team_id!="__unknown__"})) > 0)

panels.title: Victim teams by observed packets/s
panels.description: Forwarded source-to-vulnbox packets summed per destination over the last minute, using only healthy router source counters. Victim means destination, not a verdict; high volume alone does not prove malicious traffic.

targets.expr: sort_desc(((count by (source_team_ip) (((sum by (source_team_ip, team_ip) (rate(forcad_game_tcp_flows_total[1m]) and on (job, instance) forcad:game_sensor_ready)) > 0) or ((sum by (source_team_ip, team_ip) (rate(forcad_game_udp_flows_total[1m]) and on (job, instance) forcad:game_sensor_ready)) > 0))) * on (source_team_ip) group_left (source_team_name) forcad:game_source_info) > 0)

panels.title: Source teams by active target fan-out
panels.description: Distinct destination vulnboxes with new TCP or UDP flows from each source during the last minute, using only healthy game sensors. Fan-out is an investigation aid and does not establish intent.

panels.title: Checker status and duration (service context, not traffic latency)
panels.description: Recent checker CHECK outcomes from the restricted checker_action_events view. Status counts describe checker-reported service availability; measured duration is checker runtime, not HTTP request latency. Independent of packet/flow observations.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT e.service AS "Service", e.team AS "Team",
       count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 101) AS "UP",
       count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 102) AS "CORRUPT",
       count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 103) AS "MUMBLE",
       count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 104) AS "DOWN",
       count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.status = 110) AS "CHECK FAILED",
       count(e.id) FILTER (WHERE e.timed_out) AS "Timeouts",
       round(avg(e.duration_ms)::numeric, 1) AS "Mean check duration ms",
       percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY e.duration_ms) AS "p95 check duration ms",
       max(e.duration_ms) AS "Max check duration ms",
       max(e.time) AS "Last check"
FROM checker_action_events AS e
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.time) AND e.action = 'check'
GROUP BY e.service, e.team
ORDER BY max(e.time) DESC
LIMIT 200
